name: Norephedrine
summary: Phenylpropanolamine (PPA) is a sympathomimetic agent used as a decongestant and appetite suppressant. It was once common in prescription and over-the-counter cough and cold preparations. The medication is taken orally.

pharmacology.text: Phenylpropanolamine acts primarily as a selective norepinephrine releasing agent. It also acts as a dopamine releasing agent with around 10-fold lower potency. The stereoisomers of the drug have only weak or negligible affinity for α- and β-adrenergic receptors.
pharmacology.kind: Nasal decongestant; Anorectic; Norepinephrine releasing agent

uses.text: Phenylpropanolamine is used as a decongestant to treat nasal congestion. It has also been used to suppress appetite and promote weight loss in the treatment of obesity and has shown effectiveness for this indication.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of phenylpropanolamine include increased heart rate and blood pressure.

summaryZh: 苯丙醇胺，又稱去甲基麻黃素或去甲麻黃鹼，分子式C9H13NO，CAS編號：14838-15-4。是一種苯乙胺類的藥物。目前在美國，年輕婦女必須要有處方籤才能購買這種藥物，其他地區則沒有限制。一種本來很常用的收鼻水藥物，可以使阻塞的上呼吸道及氣管變得暢通。

fact.en: Phenylpropanolamine was pulled from cold remedies in many countries after studies in 2000 linked it to a raised risk of bleeding strokes in young women.
fact.zh: 2000 年的研究把苯丙醇胺與年輕女性腦出血風險升高聯繫起來後，許多國家將它從感冒藥中下架。
fact.zhHans: 2000 年的研究把苯丙醇胺与年轻女性脑出血风险升高联系起来后，许多国家将它从感冒药中下架。
